notes.note: Ambiguity: broad reading chosen (template variables/parameters/in-line templates count as templates); test uses '?' in a plain value variable initialisation, a violation under both readings.
Titan accepts: it does not check the present restriction for members of a template list (a referenced template that is '*'). Per B.1.2.1 e) this is an error.
Ambiguity: reading 'a complemented list never matches an absent optional field' chosen; executable test checks that complement(1,2) does not match omit but matches 3.
Titan accepts: it does not check the present restriction for templates referenced in a complemented list (a referenced template that is '*'). Per B.1.2.2 f) this is an error.
Ambiguity: 'evaluates to a single element' read as 'field is present with any value'; test checks '?' matches a present optional field and does not match an omitted one.

Ambiguity: reading 1 chosen (a template that is '*' as a whole used as the top-level template of a receive operation is a static error); test uses a named template, so the violation is statically detectable.
Ambiguity on strict vs non-strict 'less than': test uses (10 .. 1), which violates the rule under every reading, instead of the controversial (1 .. 1).

Titan accepts: it does not check whether universal charstring range boundaries are assigned code points. charstring (T.50) has no empty positions, so universal charstring with unassigned U+03A2 as lower boundary is used.

Uses universal charstring range U+03A1..U+03A3 around the unassigned code point U+03A2 (charstring has no empty positions); relies on the tool knowing the ISO/IEC 10646 assignment, which tools such as Titan likely do not implement (would yield fail).
